Text: Nobody drives past your business to find you a…
text.value: Nobody drives past your business to find you any more. They look you up on a phone and decide in about nine seconds. If your site loads slow, looks like it was built ten years ago, or does not plainly say what you do and where you do it, they are gone — back to Google, on to the next name, and you never knew they were there. Plenty of businesses never come up at all, because nobody ever told Google what they do. We build the site that gets found, loads fast, works on a phone, and gives a customer one obvious thing to do: call you or book you.

text.label: Heading: You cannot run a business off a Facebook page.
text.value: You cannot run a business off a Facebook page.

text.label: Text: We see a lot of owners running everything off …
text.value: We see a lot of owners running everything off Facebook or Instagram. It works right up until the day that page gets restricted or taken down — and it happens for no reason anybody ever explains to you. Every customer you spent years collecting goes with it, and you have no way left to reach them.

text.label: Text: A website you own is the one address nobody ca…
text.value: A website you own is the one address nobody can take away from you. Your Facebook page points to it. Your Google profile points to it. It is yours, and it stays yours.

text.label: Text: Friends do not let friends run a business off …
text.value: Friends do not let friends run a business off a Facebook page.

text.label: Text: Send someone our way and you both get looked a…
text.value: Send someone our way and you both get looked after — ask about the friends-and-family referral program when we talk.

props.text: If your Google profile is your website, you are renting.

A Google Business Profile and a Facebook page are good things to have. They are not a business. You do not own either one, you cannot change how they work, and everything a customer does on them happens on somebody else's terms — sitting in a list, directly beside your competitors.
No form you own, no number you capture, no way to text somebody back. A person taps through, looks around and leaves, and you never learn they were there.
There is nowhere to put instant follow-up, because there is no inquiry to follow up on. Every lead depends on you being free at the moment it lands.
You earned them. They sit on a page that also lists the three shops nearest you. On your own site those same reviews sell for you, with nobody else on the screen.
When somebody asks ChatGPT for a good one nearby, the answer is built out of websites it can read. No site, no mention.
No way to know what a customer costs you or which ad brought them. Everything is a guess, so every dollar you spend is a guess.
A suspended page, a changed policy, a lost login. Twenty years of work sitting on ground you never owned.
None of that is an argument against your Google profile.

Keep it. Feed it. It is one of the best free things a local business has. But it should point at something you own — a site that answers the questions, captures the person, replies in under a minute, and shows your reviews with no competitor beside them. The profile brings them. Your website is what closes them.

Our Smart Website is a complete business management system — a 24/7 AI booking agent, automated follow-up, booking, CRM, payments and a mobile app, all in one place. You never miss a lead, and nobody waits for an answer.

text.label: Explainer heading
text.value: A linear chatbot and conversational AI are not the same thing.

text.label: Explainer · left body
text.value: Somebody wrote the conversation in advance. It walks your customer down a list of questions in a fixed order. Step off that list — ask what it costs, raise a worry, say anything it was not expecting — and it repeats itself, shows a menu of buttons, or tells them to call back during business hours. It cannot think. It can only look things up.

text.label: Explainer · right body
text.value: The same kind of AI behind ChatGPT. You will hear it called agentic, which only means it decides what to say next instead of reading from a script. It reads what your customer actually wrote, answers in their words, handles the worry they actually raised, and keeps going — nights, weekends, holidays — until the appointment is on your calendar. Nobody wrote that conversation in advance, because nobody could.
